name: @payswap/recourse
description: Disputes, recourse, escrow, bonds and guarantees (Work Order W1-006): immutable transaction recourse policies with enforced claim windows and evidence requirements, append-only dispute cases that never rewrite original transactions, separate recourse obligations derived through the protocol obligation machinery (INV-F02 clawback discipline), separately accounted escrow/bond protection with evidence-backed release/forfeit paths, guarantee declarations with invocation windows, and dispute/recourse evidence attached to the settlement evidence graph (INV-E01/E02/E05).
